'''Yoda's quarters''' were the private living quarters of the last [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda's]] private chambers served him from his appointment to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] to the dissolution of the Order during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. Following the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] seizure of the Temple, [[Grand Inquisitor/Legends|Grand Inquisitor]] [[Malorum]] took up temporary residence within Master Yoda's old room.

==History==
[[File:YodaShadowed-ROTS.png|thumb|left|250px|Yoda sits in the shadows of his quarters.]]

These quarters were assigned to [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] upon his appointment to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|High Council]]. Within these chambers, Yoda would [[Meditation/Legends|meditate]] on [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and mentor any [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] requesting counsel.<ref name="AOTC" />

Master Yoda's quarters were open to all who needed guidance, with private meetings scheduled upon request. During his early years of training [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], Jedi [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] would visit Yoda and they would prepare [[shoo bread]] and [[wurr]] together while discussing the burden placed on Kenobi by the deceased Master [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]].<ref name="RP">''[[Rogue Planet]]''</ref>

Following Jedi Kenobi's report of the creation of a [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|clone army]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] for the use of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Master Yoda left [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu's]] [[Mace Windu's quarters|quarters]] and entered into deep meditation, searching the Force for ways to cut through the increasingly thick pall of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. Amidst his ruminations, Yoda felt [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] Anakin Skywalker's inner turmoil as he slaughtered a group of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider's]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. While the Force did not provide any of the details of Skywalker's pain, Yoda heard the voice of the deceased Master Qui-Gon Jinn urging Skywalker away from making a terrible choice. Master Windu soon after entered Yoda's quarters as the Grand Master came out of his trance and showed concern for Skywalker's fate.<ref name="AOTC" />

Immediately after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], Jedi Kenobi was sent to the [[Naboo Queen (restaurant)|apartment]] of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] by Master Yoda to warn the Senator that pursuing a relationship with Padawan Skywalker would not benefit either of them. Reporting back to Yoda's quarters, the Grand Master scolded Kenobi for allowing the relationship to get to such a dangerous point and told the Knight to train his Padawan to let go. Soon after, Master Windu joined Yoda to meditate on the news of a possible threat lurking on the planet [[Zigoola]]. Delivered to the Council by Knight Kenobi, Windu and Yoda questioned the validity of the report and eventually decided that they should not divert any troops towards a threat which hadn't yet revealed itself. Windu later revealed his need to discuss his feelings with Yoda or else he would not be able to function. Yoda encouraged him to release his fear and follow the ebb and flow of the Force. They then moved onto discuss the upcoming [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|Battle of Bothawui]] and how to lure [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. After [[Mission to Zigoola|sending]] Kenobi to Zigoola, Yoda sensed through the Force Kenobi's call to him for help. Yoda quickly contacted Senator Amidala and sent her to recover Kenobi.<ref name="TCW:WS">''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]''</ref>

Masters Yoda and Windu met in the former's room to discuss the role of the Jedi in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Master Windu was unhappy to agree with the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor's]] decision to appoint the Jedi as [[Jedi General/Legends|generals]]. Yoda concurred, but warned there were too few active Jedi and was weary of the fact that several had refused to return to Coruscant. Master [[Tholme/Legends|Tholme]] reported via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] that he had still heard no news from Jedi [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] and warned that he was most likely continuing work on his spy network within the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="R49">[[Republic 49|''Republic'' 49]]</ref>

The Grand Master spoke with Jedi Kenobi and Skywalker regarding the situation on [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]] in his chamber, events from which were brought to Kenobi's attention by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] in secret to prevent a crisis. After meditating on the information, Yoda reluctantly agreed to send the two on an [[Battle of Lanteeb|undercover mission]] to discover what the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] was doing on such a backwater; provided that the [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]] arranged false identities for them. Within days of the assignment, Yoda summoned Master Kenobi to his quarters again to take tea with him, an invitation typically exclusive to members of the High Council. While sipping the [[Yarba tea|fragrant tea]], Yoda discussed with Kenobi the darkness that had plagued the young master since his return from [[Zigoola]]. Yoda warned that death and loss awaited Kenobi on Lanteeb and to take caution and trust his feelings if he sought to prevail.<ref name="CWG:S">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]''</ref>

Later in the war, Masters Yoda, Windu, Tholme, and [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] were present in the Grand Master's quarters when Master [[Agen Kolar/Legends|Agen Kolar]] reported on the apparent defection of Jedi Quinlan Vos to the Separatists. Windu and Tholme agreed with Kolar's findings and sent the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] to capture [[Khaleen Hentz/Legends|Khaleen Hentz]] and bring her to the Temple. As Kolar signed off, Mundi was unhappy that they were forced to lie to Kolar, but Tholme insisted that it was important to keep Vos' undercover assignment top secret and Kolar would only perpetuate their subterfuge.<ref name="R54">[[Republic 54|''Republic'' 54]]</ref>

Throughout most of the war, Yoda remained on Coruscant as consultant to the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] and advisor to the Jedi Council. Yoda was meditating in his room in search of the elusive [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] when the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Separatist Navy]] [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|invaded]] the capitol. Rushing to his window to witness the assault, the Grand Master instantly began overseeing the Order's reaction to the attack and attempting to raise all available Jedi in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] and [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] Territories for assistance.<ref name="LoE">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref>

[[File:YodaCouncilsAnakin-ROTS.png|thumb|right|250px|Yoda meets with Anakin Skywalker to discuss the latter's [[Force vision/Legends|Force visions]].]]
Days after the attack and the successful counter-invasion tactics of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Fleet]], Yoda granted Jedi Skywalker a private meeting in his quarters. Plagued by [[Force vision/Legends|visions]] of the death of [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|someone close]] to him, Yoda encouraged the young Jedi to release himself of attachment and let the Force guide the hand of fate. Skywalker sat quietly through the meeting, though privately dismissing Yoda's advice as typical Jedi dogma. Soon after the meeting, Yoda departed his chambers for the final time on a mission to the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|war-torn]] planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. While away from the capitol, Supreme Chancellor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was discovered to be the elusive Darth Sidious. One of the only individuals in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to discover this terrible truth, Yoda was prepare for the attack that besieged him during [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. However, the Temple did not survive [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]], a military movement undertaken by the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]].<ref name="ROTS" />

While the Temple lay in ruin, not all of its chambers went unused. Assigned to the Temple, Grand Inquisitor Malorum set up his offices in the former residence of the exiled-Grand Master. When [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] arrived for a meeting with Malorum, the ex-Jedi [[Ferus Olin]], who had managed to infiltrate the Temple with the help of his friend [[Trever Flume]], used the time to break into the office and look through Malorum's files for signs of the rumored [[Storage floor|Jedi Prison]]. Before he could finish, Darth Vader and the Inquisitor walked into the room, causing the infiltrators to hide amidst the rubble in the hall outside. As Vader began to argue with Malorum, Olin and Flume attempted to evade notice; however Vader began whirling the Force around the office causing debris to rattle and fall lose of the ceiling. The grate behind which Olin was hidden shook free, revealing him to the Dark Lord. Using a burst of Force-assisted speed, Olin grabbed Flume and hurled himself out the window of Yoda's old quarters, using the Force to wing into the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Tower Atrium]] below.<ref name="LJU">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Underworld]]''</ref>

==Layout==
[[File:YodasQuarters-Assassin.png|thumb|left|200px|[[Yoda's crest]] was displayed on the floor and door to Yoda's quarters]]
Located off one of the hallways that wrapped around the central shaft of the [[High Council Tower/Legends|High Council Tower]], the Grand Master's quarters were hexagonal and bare, with shaded windows framed by smooth pillars. Yellow-hued, the chamber contained few pieces of furniture, including an organiform table, bed, and three tuffet meditation pads,<ref name="AOTC" /> some of which were adorned with [[Yoda's crest]]. The door to Yoda's quarters was also adorned by his crest.<ref name="ROTS" />

During the Clone Wars the chamber walls were covered in tapestries and the floor littered with lit candles.<ref name="CWG:S" /> Following the [[Battle of Thustra]], Yoda placed a rare flower from the gardens of his fallen friend [[King/Legends|King]] [[Alaric (Sephi)|Alaric]], in a vase in his chambers.<ref name="J:Y">''[[Jedi: Yoda]]''</ref>

After the fall of the Order and Inquisitor Malorum set up his office in the chamber, the room was largely shattered. The chairs had been moved to accommodate Malorum's desk and after Darth Vader stormed into the room and expressed his anger with the Inquisitor, the room's ceiling became greatly distressed and buckled.<ref name="LJU" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the shooting script of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] report from [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] is received in [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda's]] quarters, though in the final film, the scene takes place in Mace Windu's quarters&mdash;which was originally going to be an office room, before adopting the style of Yoda's chamber.
